title: State-Rejected Certificates and the Customer's Correction — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Hand-Over Reference
content:
## Subject

A corrected refiling answers a state rejection of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate with corrected information from the customer when the rejection code is one the customer must correct, and Cardinal corrects and refiles on its own when the code is one Cardinal corrects.

The corrected refiling charge is the amount booked for it, once, on the corrected refiling transmission, at 0.00 where the sum is zero. A correction received after the correction window starts a new request and is not a corrected refiling.

## What the correction records

- the corrected detail replaces the detail on the driver record — or, for a case number, on the state order record;
- the filing is set to filed;
- one corrected refiling transmission to the ordering state is recorded under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason corrected refiling is recorded on that transmission, in the amount given.

The customer sees the filing shown as filed again and the charge on the filing history.

## Invocation — a customer-run tool

**Tool:** `submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2`. The corrected detail is the customer's own: the representative unlocks the tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the rejected certificate, as read out by the representative from the filing lookup | Identifier |
| `transmission_number` | The transmission confirmation number of the transmission the state rejected, as read out by the representative from the filing history | Identifier |
| `corrected_item` | Which detail the customer corrects | Exactly one of the four values below |
| `corrected_value` | The corrected detail exactly as the customer reads it from the license or order letter | Verbatim: the same letters, digits, spaces and punctuation, character for character |
| `refiling_charge` | The corrected refiling charge the representative quoted | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

### Values of `corrected_item`

| Value | Used when | `corrected_value` holds |
|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | The state rejected the certificate for a name mismatch | The full name as printed on the license |
| `date_of_birth` | The rejection was a date of birth mismatch | The date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD |
| `license_number` | The rejection was a license number mismatch | The license number as printed |
| `case_number` | The state could not find the case | The case number from the state's order letter |

The tool records the charge it is given; it does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the corrected detail recorded, the status filed, the new transmission confirmation number of the corrected refiling (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the correction, the refiling and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.
